verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open-source rendering engine/library, not a hosted platform that stores proprietary user data behind a login; there's no 'account data' to export and leave from. While it supports open 3D file formats (glTF, OBJ, STL) for assets, that's an interoperability feature, not a data-portability/lock-in escape story, making this axis a category mismatch for this product type.
